summary.text: Steven Holt is a Republican member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 12, where Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2015, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A retired U.S. Marine Corps first sergeant, he chairs the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Steven Holt served in the U.S. Marine Corps for 20 years and reached the rank of first sergeant.
His career experience includes owning Movie Magic USA and working as a deputy sheriff and police chief, and he has served on the board of the local Music Boosters.
Holt chairs the House Judiciary Committee and for 2025-2026 also serves on the Government Oversight, Higher Education, Public Safety, and Ways and Means committees.
